updates.claim_revised: The BioZ value changes on every other frame because the producer holds the last value on skipped frames, matching the chip's 64 sps BioZ rate (CNFG_BIOZ RATE = 0 at FMSTR 32,768 Hz). The decoder's 128 sps label is the error.

updates.claim: _max30001ReadBIOZFIFO uses ECG tag bits (etag = bits 5:3) on BioZ words, where bits 5:3 are data. Only words with bits 5:4 == 0 are kept (25% under uniform synthetic data). Reached only through max30001ServiceAllInterrupts / burst APIs, not the shipped examples.
updates.status: Source-level; model in pass5/max30001_bioz_decode_model.py. Hardware untested.

updates.claim: Streaming BioZ decode returns values 16x the scale of the new API getBioZSample() (18 bits at 24-bit scale vs 20-bit value). Conversion constants are not interchangeable.
updates.status: Source plus arithmetic (median ratio 16.0 in model).

updates.claim: getECGSample() and getBioZSample() read the FIFO on every call, set sample_valid = true unconditionally, and do not check readiness or ETAG/BTAG. Shipped Example01 uses this path each loop.
updates.status: Source-level. Effect on hardware not measured.
